verdict.rationale: Unreal ships genuine official CLI surfaces — command-line arguments/launch parameters, Unreal Automation Tool (UAT), Unreal Build Tool, and cook/package/deploy commands (UnrealEditor.exe -run=cook) — all documented and usable for scripted/automated workflows that an AI agent could drive locally. However, these are general engine automation tools, not purpose-built 'AI-native' CLIs, and probe evidence shows Epic's docs/API surfaces are unreliable for headless/agent fetching (WAF 403 challenges, no official MCP, gated source repo API), undercutting agentic usability. Missing for 10: an AI-agent-oriented CLI or explicit AI tooling around the CLI, and reliable non-browser/agent access to the CLI's documentation and outputs.
